digest.component_or_area: ticket claim-session provenance and cross-session detection
propositions: claimed_session, claim_harness, and claim_remote_session fields must be cleared whenever a ticket transitions out of in_progress state

A detector function must warn when an operation targets a single ticket and the acting session id differs from the ticket's live claimed_session, gated by a warnings.cross_session config toggle (default on)
Cross-session warnings must be surfaced on CLI (stderr line), MCP (response field), and library (warnings.warn) for single-ticket operations only
Bulk read operations (list, search, ready, next-batch) must never emit cross-session warnings
The warning detection must remain silent when the acting session id is unknown (resolve_session_id returns None) or when the session id matches the claimed_session
